verified_root_cause.finding: V3 mixed globally effective object privileges with actually reachable capabilities. The administrative event-trigger helper was reachable through inherited PUBLIC schema usage; the two extension views were counted even though their schema was not reachable.
verified_root_cause.baseline_contract: The canonical baseline already revokes PUBLIC EXECUTE on public.rls_auto_enable(); production has drifted from that contract.

changes: restore the baseline PUBLIC revoke on public.rls_auto_enable()
create one static retailer-neutral read wrapper around the deployed plan-status RPC
create one reusable caller role in NOLOGIN state with no table, sequence, writer or runtime-role grants
check only capabilities reachable through schemas the caller can use

next_gate: One exact owner decision is required before applying the pending production migration. After deployment, the reusable role remains NOLOGIN until a separately bounded credential activation and one read-only status call.
